concept: A LEGO model of a small, round, chunky red bird perched on a simple ground plate, built from stacked bricks and curved slopes with a bright orange beak and wings on side studs. (changed: Flying pose replaced with a calm perched stance on a ground plate, since balance and mid-air poses aren't buildable.; Feathers and realistic plumage simplified into clean red brick color blocking with minimal detail.)
